description: Prompt-injection scanner: checks a web page, document or tool result for hidden instructions aimed at AI agents (hidden HTML, white text, comments, Unicode smuggling, base64) and injection phrases; verdict, 0-100 score, findings, optional cleaned text. Use before reading or acting on content you did not write: a fetched web page, an email, a PDF's text, another tool's result. Pass url (fetched for you), html or text. Deterministic rules, not a model. Returns verdict (clean, suspicious, likely_injection), score 0-100, findings[] {rule, severity, message, evidence, location} where location says whether the text was hidden from humans (css-hidden, white-text, html-comment, unicode-tags...), hidden {segments, chars, kinds}, summary and, with clean: true, the visible text with hidden content removed, safe to pass on. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

clean.description: Also return `clean`: the visible text with hidden and invisible content removed (default false)

html.description: Raw HTML to scan instead of a url

text.description: Plain text or markdown to scan instead of a url (a document, email, tool result)

url.description: Public page to fetch and scan (HTML is inspected for hidden elements, comments and meta tags)

name: scan_injection

clean.description: Visible text with hidden content and invisible characters removed; only with clean: true

evidence.description: Up to 240 characters of the offending text

location.description: visible, or where the hidden text sat: css-hidden, hidden-attribute, white-text, html-comment, meta-tag, alt-text, noscript, unicode-tags, zero-width, bidi-override

rule.description: Stable rule id, e.g. ignore-previous, hide-from-user, unicode-tag-smuggling

url.description: Present when a url was fetched

title: Prompt-injection scanner
